from dataclasses import dataclass
@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, repr=False)
class Num:
    _0: int
    def __repr__(self):
        return f"Num({self._0!r})"
@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, repr=False)
class Add:
    _0: object
    _1: object
    def __repr__(self):
        return f"Add({self._0!r}, {self._1!r})"
@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Point:
    x: int
    y: int
def simp(e):
    match e:
        case Add(Num(0), b):
            return b
        case Add(a, Num(0)):
            return a
        case other:
            return other
def quad(p):
    match p:
        case Point(x=0, y=0):
            _pf_t0 = "origin"
        case Point(x=0):
            _pf_t0 = "y axis"
        case Point(x=x, y=y) as whole:
            _pf_t0 = f"{x},{y} {whole.x}"
    q = _pf_t0
    return q
def name(i):
    match (i, True):
        case ("root", True):
            return "admin"
        case (s, _):
            return s
        case _:
            raise RuntimeError("non-exhaustive match")
